title: The Mother of Stone
html:
The Mother of Stone is a named Basilisk Matriarch seen at level 30.

Where to find The Mother of Stone

  • Inside The Stonegaze Sanctum · seen 2×

What it can drop

  • The Sculptor's Slab (unique Silver Shield, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 10% of landed melee hits hobble the attacker for 2.5 seconds. The hobble lasts half as long on players.
  • Gazebreaker (unique Oak Longbow, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 8% of hits hobble the target for 2 seconds. The hobble lasts half as long on players.
  • Ysra's Serpent Staff (unique Oak Staff, bound): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). 10% of damage spells poison the primary target.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
